# Equilinq

> Managed sourcing infrastructure for European SMEs — end-to-end sourcing, QC, customization, and logistics from China with transparent pricing and low MOQs.

Equilinq is a Europe-based sourcing service that bridges European brands with vetted Chinese manufacturers. We handle factory verification, multi-stage quality control, customization and private label, transparent quotes, and logistics — operating as a managed service, not a marketplace.

## How It Works (steps)

- [Submit a sourcing request](/how-it-works/submit-sourcing-request): Tell us what you need.
- [Source and vet suppliers](/how-it-works/source-and-vet-suppliers): We find verified factories.
- [Receive your quote](/how-it-works/receive-your-quote): Transparent, itemized pricing.
- [Accept and pay](/how-it-works/accept-and-pay): Secure payment to start production.
- [Production and monitoring](/how-it-works/production-and-monitoring): Live updates during manufacturing.
- [Quality control inspection](/how-it-works/quality-control-inspection): Pre-shipment QC reports.
- [Shipping and logistics](/how-it-works/shipping-and-logistics): Consolidated freight and customs.
- [Delivery and support](/how-it-works/delivery-and-support): Final delivery and after-sales.
